# `ceangal.view`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_api_docs.py from ceangal/src/view.almd; do not edit. -->

_Views and modifiers: text, col, row, styles, events, accessibility._

ceangal View — the declarative UI node.

Create with text / col / row / spacer / custom, refine with modifiers
(every modifier is View -> View), compose with ordinary functions:

  v.col([v.text("Hello") |> v.font(20.0), button("Run", on_run)])
    |> v.padding(16.0) |> v.gap(8.0) |> v.bg(theme.surface)

Event handlers are closures stored on the node.

```almide
import ceangal.view
```

```almide
type Color = snaidhm.Color
```

### `Style`

```almide
type Style = {
  width: Float, height: Float, width_pct: Float, height_pct: Float,
  min_width: Float, min_height: Float, max_width: Float, max_height: Float,
  pt: Float, pr: Float, pb: Float, pl: Float,
  mt: Float, mr: Float, mb: Float, ml: Float,
  grow: Float, shrink: Float, gap: Float,
  justify: Int, align: Int, align_self: Int,
  absolute: Bool,
  overlay: Bool,
  pos_top: Float, pos_right: Float, pos_bottom: Float, pos_left: Float,
  clip: Bool,
  wrap: Bool,
  bg: Color, fg: Color,
  radius: Float, opacity: Float,
  border_width: Float, border_color: Color,
  shadow_blur: Float, shadow_dy: Float, shadow_color: Color,
  font_size: Float, mono: Bool, bold: Bool,
  cursor: Int,
}
```

### `Pointer`

```almide
type Pointer = { phase: Int, x: Float, y: Float, w: Float, h: Float, buttons: Int, mods: Int, id: Int }
```

A pointer event as handlers see it: position relative to the node.

### `Painter`

```almide
type Painter = (Float, Float, Float, Float) -> Unit
```

A custom node paints itself into its laid-out rect (logical px) and may
claim pointer events. `key` identifies it across frames.

### `View`

```almide
type View = {
  kind: Int,
  children: List[View],
  content: String,
  style: Style,
  key: String,
  on_click: () -> Unit,
  clickable: Bool,
  on_pointer: (Pointer) -> Bool,
  pointer: Bool,
  on_wheel: (Float, Float, Float, Float) -> Bool,   // (x, y, dx, dy) in node px
  wheel: Bool,
  // A right-click or a long press: (x, y) in window px.
  on_context: (Float, Float) -> Unit,
  context: Bool,
  // A vertical scroll view (see scroll_y): children move up by the offset
  // ceangal keeps for `key`; wheel and touch drag scroll it.
  scroller: Bool,
  // Keyboard focus: a focusable node (it needs a key) receives key and text
  // events while focused; `text_input` asks the host for IME / soft keyboard.
  focusable: Bool,
  text_input: Bool,
  // Taps inside leave focus where it is (a key bar above the soft keyboard).
  keeps_focus: Bool,
  on_key: (Int, Int, Int) -> Bool,           // (phase, key, mods)
  on_text: (Int, String, Int) -> Bool,       // (kind, text, preedit cursor)
  on_focus: (Bool) -> Unit,
  paint: Painter,
  label: String,
  role: Int,
  // Text an assistive technology reads as the node's value (text fields,
  // editors). Called once per committed frame, so keep it cheap.
  value: () -> String,
  // State an assistive technology announces: 4 selected, 8 checked,
  // 16 disabled (docs/abi.md §4.4).
  states: Int,
}
```


A view that paints itself: `paint(x, y, w, h)` gets its laid-out rect in

## Flex

### `grow`

```almide
pub fn grow(v: View, g: Float) -> View
```

How much of the free space along the parent's axis this view takes
(relative to its siblings' grow; 0 = none).

### `shrink`

```almide
pub fn shrink(v: View, s: Float) -> View
```

How much this view gives up when its siblings do not fit (0 = never
smaller than its content).

### `Justify`

```almide
type Justify = | Start | End | Center | Between | Around | Evenly
```

Main-axis distribution and cross-axis alignment. (Variants rather than Int
constants: a dependency's top-level `let` cannot be referenced from an app
on the wasm leg yet — almide/almide#3286.)

```almide
type Align = | Top | Bottom | Middle | Stretch
```

### `justify`

```almide
pub fn justify(v: View, j: Justify) -> View
```

Where a row's or column's children sit along its axis.

### `align`

```almide
pub fn align(v: View, a: Align) -> View
```

Where a row's or column's children sit across its axis (Stretch fills it).

### `align_self`

```almide
pub fn align_self(v: View, a: Align) -> View
```

This view's own alignment across its parent's axis.

### `center`

```almide
pub fn center(v: View) -> View
```

## Position

### `absolute`

```almide
pub fn absolute(v: View) -> View
```

Out of the flow: placed in the parent by top / bottom / left / right
(both of a pair given and no size: it spans between them).

### `overlay`

```almide
pub fn overlay(v: View) -> View
```

Over everything: placed like `absolute` (in its parent, by top / left…),
but drawn after the whole window, given pointer input first, and not
clipped by its ancestors. For popups: a dropdown's list, a menu.

### `top`

```almide
pub fn top(v: View, t: Float) -> View
```

With absolute: distance from the parent's top edge.

### `bottom`


### `right`

### `clip`

```almide
pub fn clip(v: View) -> View
```

Children do not draw outside this view's rect.

### `wrapped`

```almide
pub fn wrapped(v: View) -> View
```

Text that wraps onto as many lines as its width needs (breaking where

## Interaction

### `on_click`

```almide
pub fn on_click(v: View, f: () -> Unit) -> View
```

Run `f` on a click or tap (press and release on the view); the pointer
becomes a hand over it. Give it a role and label for screen readers.

### `on_pointer`

```almide
pub fn on_pointer(v: View, f: (Pointer) -> Bool) -> View
```

Every pointer event over the view (and, once pressed, until release):
return true to take it (drags, sliders). Positions are relative to the view.

### `on_wheel`

```almide
pub fn on_wheel(v: View, f: (Float, Float, Float, Float) -> Bool) -> View
```

Scroll wheel / trackpad deltas over the view: f(x, y, dx, dy); true = taken.

### `on_context`

```almide
pub fn on_context(v: View, f: (Float, Float) -> Unit) -> View
```

A right-click on the view, or a long press on a touch screen (0.5 s
without moving): f(x, y), the point in window logical px. Its release
does nothing else.

### `scroll_y`

```almide
pub fn scroll_y(v: View, key: String) -> View
```

Make a view scroll its content vertically when it is taller than the view
(give it a height or max height). `key` keeps the offset across frames.

### `focusable`

```almide
pub fn focusable(v: View, k: String) -> View
```

Can hold keyboard focus, under key `k` (Tab moves between such views;
on_key receives keys while focused).

### `text_input`

```almide
pub fn text_input(v: View, k: String) -> View
```

Focusable and takes text: the host shows the IME and, on phones, the
soft keyboard (on_text receives the text).

### `keeps_focus`

```almide
pub fn keeps_focus(v: View) -> View
```

Taps inside leave focus where it is (a key bar above the soft keyboard).

### `on_key`

```almide
pub fn on_key(v: View, f: (Int, Int, Int) -> Bool) -> View
```

Keys while this view has focus: f(phase, code, mods), true = handled
(phase 0 down, 1 up, 2 repeat; codes in docs/abi.md §2.2).

### `on_text`

```almide
pub fn on_text(v: View, f: (Int, String, Int) -> Bool) -> View
```

Text while this view has focus: f(kind, text, preedit cursor), true =
handled (kind 0 commit, 1 IME preedit, 2 preedit end, 3 paste).

### `on_focus`

```almide
pub fn on_focus(v: View, f: (Bool) -> Unit) -> View
```

Called with true when the view gains focus, false when it loses it.

### `cursor`

```almide
pub fn cursor(v: View, kind: Int) -> View
```

The mouse cursor over the view: 0 arrow, 1 text, 2 hand, 3 grab,
4 left-right resize, 5 up-down resize.

### `key`

```almide
pub fn key(v: View, k: String) -> View
```

Name the view: focus, scroll offsets, rect_of and hover go by keys.

## Accessibility

### `label`

```almide
pub fn label(v: View, l: String) -> View
```

What a screen reader says for the view (and what tests click by).

### `role`

```almide
pub fn role(v: View, r: Int) -> View
```

What a screen reader calls the view: 3 button, 4 text, 5 text field,
6 list, 7 list item, 8 tab, 9 tab list, 10 heading, 11 link, 12 checkbox,
13 image, 14 code editor, 15 switch, 16 slider, 17 dialog, 18 radio button,
19 radio group, 20 progress bar.

### `a11y_hidden`

```almide
pub fn a11y_hidden(v: View) -> View
```

Leave the view out of the accessibility tree (a parent speaks for it, as
the words of a wrapped paragraph).

### `value`

```almide
pub fn value(v: View, f: () -> String) -> View
```

The value a screen reader reads (a field's text, a slider's number);
called once per committed frame, so keep it cheap.

### `checked`

```almide
pub fn checked(v: View, on: Bool) -> View
```

Announced as checked (a checkbox, switch or radio button: give it that role).

### `selected`

```almide
pub fn selected(v: View, on: Bool) -> View
```

Announced as the selected one (a tab, a list item, a segment).

### `disabled`

```almide
pub fn disabled(v: View, on: Bool) -> View
```

Announced as unavailable. It only marks the view: leave out its handlers
too (the ceangal.widgets controls do).

### `expanded`

```almide
pub fn expanded(v: View, open: Bool) -> View
```

Announced as opening a popup, and whether it is open (a dropdown, a menu button).
